verdict.rationale: Riskified is a SaaS fraud-prevention platform that ingests merchant order and customer data, so choosing a data-storage region or residency is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection, residency options, or where data is stored; the docs cover only APIs, integrations, notifications, SSO and chargebacks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
